purpose: IDispatchHook that accrues a phUSD 'mint debt' equal to ratio% of every USDS amount dispatched through its registered BalancerPoolerV2. onDispatch (gated to the dispatcher) increments mintDebt; pull() (owner or recipient) realises the debt by minting phUSD to recipient and zeroing the ledger.

localFindings.description: Doc/comment state ratio must be 'strictly < MAX_RATIO (50)' and 'max settable ratio is MAX_RATIO - 1' (49). The implementation reverts only when `newRatio > MAX_RATIO`, so newRatio == 50 is accepted and DEFAULT_RATIO is 50. The 'strictly less than 50' invariant is therefore NOT enforced (50% is reachable). Off-by-one between documentation and the bound check. Low impact (50% is owner-controlled and within plausible design), but the stated invariant does not hold.
localFindings.recommendation: Either change the check to `newRatio >= MAX_RATIO` (enforce <50) or update the docs/DEFAULT_RATIO to reflect that 50 is a valid maximum. Confirm intended cap with the story.

localFindings.description: onDispatch trusts the `amount` argument forwarded by the dispatcher (gross dispatched USDS) and accrues ratio% as phUSD debt with no cap or backing check. pull() mints that debt as fresh phUSD to recipient. The hook holds unilateral phUSD minting authority; total minted phUSD over time = sum(ratio_i * amount_i)/100 across dispatches. Whether the minted phUSD is economically backed by the pooled sUSDS / donated USDC is an econ-scanner concern, not a local defect.
localFindings.recommendation: Flag for econ-scanner: phUSD mint-debt vs collateral (sUSDS pooled, USDC donated) backing ratio.

localFindings.description: setDispatcher repoints the dispatcher permitted to call onDispatch. The NatSpec advises pulling outstanding mintDebt before repointing so the ledger is clean across a swap. Not enforced in code; a careless repoint mid-debt mixes debt accrued from two dispatchers into one ledger. Owner action with a non-obvious consequence (ledger attribution) — operational hazard, owner-recoverable.
localFindings.recommendation: Document the pull-before-repoint ordering in operator runbook; optional require(mintDebt == 0) in setDispatcher.

externalEntryPoints.notes: Zero allowed (re-arms; pull reverts while zero).

externalEntryPoints.function: mintDebt / dispatcher / recipient / ratio / phUSD / MAX_RATIO / DEFAULT_RATIO

externalCalls.trustLevel: trusted (this hook is authorized minter of phUSD)
externalCalls.notes: Unilateral mint to recipient on pull().

valueFlows: ACCRUE: on each dispatch, mintDebt += amount*ratio/100 (no token movement).
REALISE: pull() mints `mintDebt` phUSD to recipient and resets mintDebt to 0. This is the contract that creates new phUSD supply backed (economically) by the pooled/donated USDS.
invariants: Only the registered dispatcher can grow mintDebt.
pull() mints exactly the outstanding mintDebt and zeros it atomically (CEI: mintDebt=0 before mint).
pull() reverts while recipient == 0; no-ops while mintDebt == 0.
ratio bound: code enforces ratio <= 50 (note doc says <50; LOCAL-HOOK-001).
trustAssumptions: This hook is granted phUSD mint authority — it is a privileged minter; owner is trusted to set a sane ratio and recipient.
The registered dispatcher faithfully forwards the gross dispatched USDS amount to onDispatch.
phUSD backing/solvency vs minted debt is governed off-this-contract (econ concern).
